messages:
Maria (AE): Hey team — need help approving a promo for Skylark (YC W22). They want a 6-week POC with higher-than-standard free credit. Can we do 25k credits + 30 days of support? They argue ramp will spike token usage.
Raj (SE): What's the workload? Which models / concurrency?
Maria (AE): Mostly chat + retrieval, ~800 req/day, avg 180 tokens in prompt+response. No heavy embeddings besides a small vector index.
Raj (SE): Quick est: ```800 * 180 = 144k tokens/day -> ~4.3M tokens/month``` If they hit spikes 2x, could be ~9M. Which model are they asking for? gpt-x-8k (quantized).
Lee - SalesOps: Default startup program is 10k credits + 30 days. Anything >10k needs Deal Desk signoff. Link to form: https://redwood.internal/sales/credit-request
Maria (AE): They're asking specifically for 25k because they want to run end-to-end benchmarks and a live demo for investors. Can we approve 25k one-off?
Camille (Deal Desk): We can consider an uplift but need commercial quid pro quo. Options: 1) 12k free credits + 3-month usage commitment at $2k/mo reserved = 24k total commitment OR 2) 20k credits but with an intro to our partner program (marketing credit) and 90-day telemetry agreement. Which does the customer prefer?
Maria (AE): Customer prefers no up-front commit — they're pre-revenue. Willing to add a short case study / reference and a product feedback call.
Camille (Deal Desk): Case study + reference is useful but not always a substitute for cost. We can approve 18k credits + 60 days if they sign an NDA + opt into a 30-minute product interview and grant marketing permission. That's our counter.
Raj (SE): From infra POV 18k seems safe if we limit peak model to lower-cost variants automatically (policy routing). I can add a route to fallback to gpt-x-lite for spikes.
Maria (AE): Sounds workable. Camille — is that something you can sign off on now? I can get the NDA and interview scheduled.
Camille (Deal Desk): I can approve 18k credits, 60 days, NDA + 30-min interview. Add note: no additional custom SLAs, and we limit streaming retention to standard. Please fill the credit request form and attach customer email thread.
sec-bot: Automated check — customer is not asking for VPC or SOC data; SSO recommended. If they request data residency, we need privacy review.
Maria (AE): Copy. I'll send the form and the NDA link to Skylark and loop in Raj for routing config. Thanks :raised_hands:
Lee - SalesOps: I'll update the promo tracker and set expiry reminder 60 days out. :white_check_mark:
Camille (Deal Desk): Tag me when you upload the completed form (camille).
Maria (AE): Will do.
